_about: The levels whose books this app shows (On this computer), in this order. branch: the branch of the library their books are in, from the main branch down (made if it is not there yet; admins can move it in the app after). folder: where the level's disc is unpacked (.shared) and its books are built (web/data, by web/tools/build_all.ps1 -Root <folder>); relative to this app's folder. id: letters or digits, for the addresses of its files (/levels/<id>/...).
